question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) in relation to environmental impacts, sustainability, lifecycle information?
description: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) is an analytical methodology to analyze and quantify environmental aspects and impacts of product systems over their life cycle. It helps in understanding the environmental effects of a product or process from raw material extraction to end-of-life disposal. LCA is used in product development and improvement, and it provides a framework for evaluating the sustainability of a product or system. It also helps in identifying areas for improvement and reducing environmental impacts. LCA data, such as EPDs, offer a standardised set of information that can be linked to materials passports, facilitating the integration of lifecycle information into decision-making processes.
